whatIncludes.title: What does this free Discovery include?
whatIncludes.subtitle: Video call with the founders of Synthetiq Partners + Document with Micro-Roadmap

items.question: What exactly is a Discovery session?
items.answer: It's a 30-minute video call with one of the founders of Synthetiq Partners where we analyze your agency, identify AI opportunities, and provide you with a personalized micro-roadmap.

items.question: How much does the Discovery session cost?
items.answer: The Discovery session is completely free and without commitment. Our goal is to help you gain clarity on how AI can benefit your agency.

items.question: What do I get after the session?
items.answer: You will receive a personalized Micro-Roadmap for the next 30 days, which includes: key pain point identified, suggested automation, and priority action to implement.

items.question: Do I need prior technical knowledge?
items.answer: No, it's not necessary. Our approach is practical and business-oriented, without technicalities. We explain everything clearly and accessibly for any profile.

calendar.title: Select a date and time on the calendar and schedule your Discovery session.
